description: Trigger evals for dv:closeout (close out a finished worktree session: verify ticket, PRs and worktree contents, brief the parent session, say whether the worktree is safe to delete). Hard near-misses in no_trigger: a handoff for work that continues (dv:handoff), orienting at session start (dv:pickup), merging a PR, deleting a merged branch, creating a worktree or its setup script (dv:orca-setup), and marking a ticket Done. See tooling/evals/README.md.

queries.q: This worktree's work is finished. Close it out and brief the parent session.
Is this worktree safe to delete? Check that nothing in it is unmerged.
Close out this session: the PR merged and the ticket is done.
Write a note for the main checkout's session about what this worktree shipped, then tell me if I can remove it.
We're done here. Wrap up this worktree and tell the home session what happened.
Before I delete this worktree, verify the ticket state and every PR this branch opened.
Closeout.
The ticket for this worktree is finished. Brief the parent and archive this session's handoff.
Can this worktree go? Tell me what would be lost if I removed it now.
Finish up this worktree session and put a summary for the main session on my clipboard.
Write a handoff for this session, I'll continue tomorrow.
Pick up where we left off.
Merge the PR for this branch.
Create a new worktree for the billing fix.
Write an Orca setup script so new worktrees get their .env copied in.
Mark VIL-210 as Done now that the PR merged.
Delete the merged branch locally and on origin.
Close the GitHub issue about the broken link.
Save my progress with focus: finish the parser tests.
List the other sessions working in this repo.
